purpose: Scratch-level numerical check of two sketches on P-20261016-claude-interactive-03: Im zeta_max <= ||q||_inf for ZS bound states, and that phase shaping at fixed spectral amplitude does not raise Im zeta_max or int|q|^4 above the transform-limited value.
method: Fourier-collocation ZS eigenvalues (n=384 and 640 on [-24,24]); eigenvalues kept if they agree across the two grids to 2e-3.
caveats: small spurious eigenvalues near the continuum remain after the two-grid filter (Im<0.2) and are ignored
40 random masks of one family; not an optimization
no Raman, TOD or propagation: input soliton content only
